title: Great Chairs!
text: Great Chairs!. My daughter just moved into a new apartment. It's unfurnished so we've been trying to fill it. These are great chairs! They are very sturdy and they look nice. The assembly is easy and straight forward. The only thing I don't like is that there's a brand tag on the seat. Most furniture pieces don't have their brand name on them in a visible spot.
